body:
"Data considered sensitive in the context of the application is clearly identified." is to vague. 
Why not just state: "The data protection requirements concerning confidentiality, integrity, authenticity and availability are identified." 
It's the basis for an informed assessment of the residual risks in case of implementaition errors.
